title: Social Analyzer Output
description: Username profile discoveries across social media. One dataset record per detected profile (with confidence rating, country, category, extracted metadata) plus one summary record with aggregate counts.

detectedProfiles.title: Detected Profiles
detectedProfiles.description: One record per discovered profile. Fields: username, platform (site name), link (full profile URL), status (good/maybe/bad), rate (% confidence), country, type (site category), language, rank, extracted (URLs/patterns if --extract), metadata (page metadata if --metadata). Final record has recordType=summary with counts and the executed command.
